node.statement: Witness ledger for the linearization radius: instantiate lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization once, obtaining universal witnesses C_A < infinity and eta_A > 0 with the stated value of C_A and the stated conclusion for every 0 <= eta <= eta_A. Introduce no additional hypothesis, but name that positive witness rho_AI := eta_A. Consequently rho_id^corr = min{rho_theta,rho_AI,epsilon_E/C_A} implies eta <= rho_AI = eta_A, exactly the domain hypothesis required to invoke lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization.
